newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midco products prices track NYMEX higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midco products prices track NYMEX higher.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel basis tracked rising NYMEX futures prices late Monday, traders said.
Chicago unleaded gasoline differentials firmed modestly but diesel differentials appeared unaffected by reports of a fire that trimmed runs at a BP refinery serving the Chicago market, traders said.
BP said a fire on Saturday trimmed crude runs and idled a vacuum distillation unit at the company's 155,000 barrel per day Toledo, Ohio refinery.
"Unleaded firmed a little, but not much," one trader said.

In after-hours trade, NYMEX front-month unleaded hit a contract high 68.75 cents a gallon before falling back, while heating oil was easing to 73.80 cents a gallon bid, 73.95 cents asked after settling at 74.07 cents a gallon in the floor session.
Chicago unleaded gasoline was talked 1.25/1.0 cent under the print for all October timings, with premium steady at 2.50 cents higher, traders said.
Group Three unleaded was unchanged at 1.0/0.75 cent under for prompt deliveries and 1.50/1.25 cent under for later deliveries, with premium steady at 3.50 cents higher.
Diesel differentials were largely unchanged in both markets late in the day.
